title: factory-readiness-findings consumed
description: The durable one-use consumption marker for the round-1 readiness-findings artifact (BLOCKER 4). The trusted orchestrator writes this write-once marker under the ignored .factory-state/ evidence namespace at the exact moment it consumes the readiness-findings artifact for the round-1 planner. The marker binds the campaign id, the readiness nonce, and the SHA-256 digest of the exact product-findings payload consumed, so a genuine replay (a different campaign, nonce, or digest) fails closed and a crash-window re-consume of the same run is accepted idempotently only when the marker bytes are byte-exact.
